title: CELL does not trim info_type, reads the active cell when reference is omitted, and returns a two-element {width, is_default} array for "width"
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, CELL matches info_type case-insensitively without trimming whitespace (so CELL(" format ", B2) is #VALUE!). Omitting reference reads the workbook's active cell (so CELL("address") on another sheet returns the active sheet and cell such as [oracle.xlsx]Data!$A$1). CELL("width", ref) returns a 1x2 array {width, is_default} where width is the rounded column width (0 when hidden) and is_default is TRUE/FALSE; legacy formulas implicitly intersect this array to the width number. CELL("prefix", ref) emits ', ", ^, or \ only for text constants and "" for numbers, formulas, logicals, errors, and blanks.
basis: Measured across all 764 CELL readings in DnaCalc dcuar_cell (Excel 16.0.20527.20088) and matched on 2,862/2,862 full-bank CELL rows.
